prompt: CSS writing modes Ogham vertical intrinsic direction
answer: Ogham’s vertical intrinsic direction is **bottom-to-top (btt)**. Its intrinsic transform is **−90° clockwise**. CSS Writing Modes notes that mixed vertical typesetting cannot automatically handle Ogham; `sideways-lr` can be used to typeset Ogham passages.
